findings.title: Shared deployment aliases redirect working demo pages to a www 404
findings.why_it_matters: Existing noncanonical demo links on the neutral deployment alias stop working after promotion: /demo/nyhavna-nettside currently returns 200, but the candidate redirects that same path to www where it returns 404. The website handoff is intended for the apex; applying it to every deployment host removes an existing compatibility surface.
findings.validation_reason: The new hosted-mode branch has no hostname guard and therefore redirects a neutral-alias request for /demo/nyhavna-nettside to https://www.placy.no (proxy.ts:41-48) before its existing shared-tree page can render, while the inspected old-site check records that destination as 404 (.context/slug-www-before.json:13-18); the precondition is an alias request with PLACY_HOSTED_VOICE=true, and the supplied candidate reproduction establishes that reachable compatibility regression.

evidence: Reviewed app/robots.ts:30-31 allows every path when PLACY_HOSTED_VOICE=true; .context/slug-candidate-crawlers.json confirms deployed Allow: /.
app/[slug]/page.tsx:10,18 uses force-dynamic and resolveVoiceProject; lib/live/projects.ts:34-37,71-73 queries voice_projects for valid unknown slugs.
Previously /p/<unknown> was already crawlable and incurred the same lookup; the change broadens exposure, rather than introducing the query cost itself.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep project URLs crawlable so their noindex directives can be read, and keep customer slugs out of robots.txt and sitemap. Choose page-only protection for unknown-slug lookups, such as a bounded short-lived negative cache or request budget, or explicitly accept the exposure with request/query monitoring. Preserve uncached paid-admission checks and verify newly enabled slugs become reachable.
findings.title: Root crawler access increases uncached registry lookup exposure
findings.why_it_matters: In hosted mode, a crawler requesting an unknown valid root slug reaches the dynamic page and performs an uncached indexed registry query before 404. Allowing all root paths expands the exposed namespace beyond the already-crawlable /p/ route. Extra database work is established; crawler volume, saturation and real-user impact were not measured.
findings.validation_reason: With PLACY_HOSTED_VOICE=true the diff emits User-Agent: * Allow: / (app/robots.ts:30-31), while any lowercase non-reserved one-segment path passes isPublicProjectSlug (lib/project-paths.ts:13-14), reaches the force-dynamic catch-all (app/[slug]/page.tsx:10,18), and invokes the uncached readBinding Supabase query (lib/live/projects.ts:34-37,71-73); this newly exposes bot probes to one database lookup per request, though actual crawler volume and saturation incidence were not measured.
